Assistant B is better. It lists exactly three impacts, as the user asked, and covers both the Alps and the Rhine. Its points on natural barriers, fertile land and river transport are sound. The tourism point is less tied to settlement and agriculture, but it is still reasonable.

Assistant A gives ten items instead of three, and items 3 through 10 are the same sentence repeated. It also never mentions the Rhine or agriculture, so it does not answer the question.

[[B]]
